I met another emaciated dog, are we shocked? I know I’m not, everyday there’s a new dog barely hanging on by a thread. Yet people still support backyard breeders and puppy mills, doesn’t this just break your heart? I can’t wrap my mind around it and I’m done trying to. So anyway, meet Alfie. I’m seriously jealous of the lucky person who gets to adopt and come home to him everyday, he’s such a sweetheart. I don’t believe Alfie is a true stray because we live in a big city and we have a lot of street feeders. Our strays out here typically are thicker with some rough skin from fleas etc. but completely emaciated means to me someone was keeping him like this. He has what appears to be maybe a sore on his butt from sitting in urine or feces. He needs someone who is familiar with a feeding diet and who can help get him on the road to being a healthy boy. I pray someone gives him a chance.  •Questions?
